title: A good idea
blurb: A big meeting at the insurance company.

paragraphs.zh: 我在大学学习精算，也在一家保险公司工作。我的办公室在十层。
paragraphs.en: I study actuarial science at university and also work at an insurance company. My office is on the tenth floor.

paragraphs.zh: 我的工作主要是用电脑算风险。我的同事都很好，我们常常一起吃午饭。
paragraphs.en: My work is mainly calculating risk on the computer. My colleagues are all nice; we often have lunch together.

paragraphs.zh: 今天有一个很重要的会议。经理说：“这个问题我们需要解决，可是我们还没有办法。”
paragraphs.en: Today there was an important meeting. The manager said: "We need to solve this problem, but we don't have a way yet."

paragraphs.zh: 我想了一会儿，然后说：“我有一个办法。”大家都看着我。
paragraphs.en: I thought for a moment, then said: "I have an idea." Everyone looked at me.

paragraphs.zh: 我介绍了我的办法。经理说：“好！就这么做。”
paragraphs.en: I explained my idea. The manager said: "Good! Let's do it that way."

paragraphs.zh: 晚上我给女朋友打电话：“今天经理用了我的办法！”她说：“我为你高兴！”
paragraphs.en: In the evening I called my girlfriend: "Today the manager used my idea!" She said: "I'm happy for you!"
